verdicts.reason: A breaks the illustration apart: the circle is a cropped stub at the far left, and the can floats alone at the far right with dead space around it. The SOLSTICE wordmark sits under the headline, and the CTA is a tiny pill on the left, no bigger than the badges, so the hierarchy is buried. B keeps a sensible left-to-right flow (brand, headline, badges, CTA on the right, which is dominant), but the backdrop circle is stretched into a squashed full-width ellipse. The can is shrunk and jammed into the corner on that ellipse, the body copy is tiny and ends on an orphan 'bottles.', and the CTA sits tight against the right edge.
